acceptance_tests: Confirm the implemented board uses a USB-C power connector; flag the current J1 USB_B_Micro designation as a discrepancy if unchanged.
Confirm VBUS and GND from the USB-C connector reach the board power circuitry and that +3V3 powers U1 and U2.
Confirm exactly one TMP102 temperature sensor is connected to the ESP32 through I2C SDA and SCL nets.
Confirm ESP32 EN, USB_D+, and USB_D- connectivity against the design pin/net tables.
Rerun ERC independently and report final errors and warnings; do not accept unresolved violations without an issue list.
Rerun DRC independently and report final errors and warnings; do not accept unresolved violations without an issue list.
Confirm the final board outline does not exceed 110 mm by 65 mm and the fabrication target is two layers.
constraints: Propose requirements only; do not modify the project.
The responsible return target is the PCB engineering team lead/design-validation team.
Review and resolve the stated ERC baseline of 10 errors and 8 warnings against the requirements.
Review and resolve the stated DRC baseline of 5 errors and 13 warnings against the requirements.
Project manager must consolidate implementation and validation results and return either an accepted design package or an issue list.
The supplied J1 pin table identifies USB_B_Micro while the project request requires USB-C; this interface must be reconciled before acceptance.
